short.q: State the data type you would use for (a) a person's height in metres, (b) the number of students in a class, (c) whether a door is open.
points: integer for count and Boolean for open

short.q: Write the result and show how it is found: 47 MOD 10 and 47 DIV 10.
short.model: 47 MOD 10 = 7, the last digit (remainder); 47 DIV 10 = 4, the whole-number part.

short.q: Write a Python loop that prints the numbers 1 to 10.
Explain why a user's age input must be converted with int() in Python before comparing it with 18.
short.model: input() returns a string and a string cannot be properly compared with a number, so it must be converted to an integer first.
points: needs converting to an integer to compare/calculate

short.q: Explain the difference between a WHILE loop and a REPEAT … UNTIL loop.
short.model: A WHILE loop tests its condition before each pass, so it may never run. REPEAT … UNTIL tests after each pass, so it always runs at least once.
points: WHILE tests first / may run zero times
REPEAT tests at end / runs at least once
